newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Central Bank trims interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Chile Central Bank trims interest rates.

text.p: Chile's Central Bank said it has cut interbank interest rates by 0.25 percentage point, the second easing of its tight monetary policy in two months.
Interbank rates fell to seven percent from 7.25 percent with effect on Monday.
The bank said it will continue monitoring the economy and may make further reductions in short-term interest rates, provided inflation remains under control.

"The council will continue evaluating economic, financial and monetary developments to introduce changes in liquidity in the system and in short-term interest rates which correspond to changes in inflation," said the statement.
The authorities have set an inflation target of 5.5 percent this year.
The bank last cut interest rates by 0.25 percentage point February 6 in the first relaxing of the tight credit policy it has kept in force for over a year.
